== Description ==
Meet the farmers in Hay Day from all around the world!

In this 8th episode of the series you’ll get to meet Karuna from Bangkok, Thailand.

Get to see how Hay Day has become her number one hobby and allowed her to meet new friends all around the world. She is also an admin in social media Hay Day groups where she motivates and guides other players. Hay Day has also fulfilled her dream of having a farm of her own!
